reviews.text:
Had a really good experience at this shop in Phuket Old Town. The owner is extremely friendly, welcoming, and genuinely nice. He took the time to explain the different products and made the whole experience feel relaxed rather than like a typical tourist shop.

The “coffee” is very good quality, clean, and fresh. You can tell that attention is paid to the quality of the products, and there is a good selection to choose from depending on what you’re looking for.

I also noticed they have a large variety of CBD and THC products, so there are plenty of options beyond just the usual “coffee.” The selection is quite impressive, and the products are presented professionally.

As for the prices, I think they are fair and reasonable for Phuket Old Town, especially considering the quality and the service. I’ve seen places in tourist areas charging considerably more.

Overall, I would definitely recommend checking this shop out. Friendly owner, good-quality and clean products, fair prices, and a good selection of CBD and THC products. It’s always nice to find a place where the service feels personal and genuine rather than just focused on making a quick sale.
